classes.title: Problem Solving & Object-Oriented Programming
classes.description: The foundational Purdue CS course in Java. Covers problem decomposition, control flow, arrays, and the pillars of object-oriented design: classes, encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism, interfaces, exceptions, and file I/O.

units.title: Midterm 1
units.description: Weeks 1–4: variables and primitive types, operators, conditionals, loops, methods, and introductory 1D arrays. Practice exams coming soon.

units.title: Midterm 2
units.description: Weeks 5–7: classes & objects, encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism & dynamic dispatch, interfaces & default methods, custom checked/unchecked exceptions, and file I/O. Four full-length autograded practice exams.

units.title: Midterm 3
units.description: Weeks 8–11: recursion, 2D arrays, searching & sorting, ArrayLists and generics, and an introduction to algorithmic complexity. Practice exams coming soon.

units.title: Midterm 4
units.description: Weeks 12–15: multithreading, synchronization, GUIs with event handling, and networking fundamentals. Practice exams coming soon.

classes.title: Programming in C
classes.description: Systems programming in C: pointers and memory management, structs, dynamic allocation, the preprocessor, modular compilation, and the standard library. Scaffolding placeholder — practice content coming soon.

classes.title: Foundations of Computer Science
classes.description: Discrete mathematics for computing: logic and proofs, set theory, functions and relations, induction, combinatorics, and introductory graph theory. Scaffolding placeholder — practice content coming soon.

classes.title: Data Structures & Algorithms
classes.description: Core data structures and their algorithms: lists, stacks, queues, trees, heaps, hash tables, and graphs, with analysis of time and space complexity. Scaffolding placeholder — practice content coming soon.
